title: Global Health Architecture and Health Systems Transition
discussion_signal: The discussion frames global-health transition as a systems problem involving domestic budget pathways, workforce, surveillance, procurement, and country-led prioritization rather than simply a question of adding money.
linked_research_question: How do overlapping institutions, funding cycles, governance voice, and transition burdens shape global-health capacity beyond available money?
limits: The post is expert commentary and does not provide a comparative financing dataset
It does not establish which reforms improve outcomes
Consulting framing may underrepresent political contestation and community perspectives
